svg.title: Search and target recovery · distinct missing-data states — static design, not live data

g.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
g.text: OASIS7 / VIEWER • DESIGN REBUILD
Search and target recovery · distinct missing-data states
Static contract / illustrative values only / not a runtime screenshot
Search authorized space
Separate from Targets local filtering; max 128 characters
Authorized search
Illustrative query
Search
World overview
Return to target
Submit stops following. Overview clears query/follow.
Return keeps the gameplay subject; no trusted location
shows target_unavailable instead of invented camera.
Targets · waiting for snapshot
No snapshot: not a truthful zero-entity world
Entity list pending / loading progress.
Keep current authorized context only.
No empty-world conclusion until snapshot exists.
Targets · snapshot has no entities
Empty list and filtered result are not permission grants
No agents in current snapshot.
No locations in current snapshot.
Use published recovery action when available.
Do not invent entities or a claim entitlement.
Spatial result left query / event absent
Different explanations must remain different
world_deleted=true → confirmed world removal
Otherwise: left query, not proof of deletion.
Event absent from current Feed → no substitute.
Source-frozen → historical view at one source cut.
W14-search-empty • Fixed source PR 113868200d1f • editable SVG • no runtime verification
